title: Explorer header and notices
responsibility: Provides explorer navigation and visible data-loading or missing-address messages.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.base
inputs.description: Required mount of the console, the explorer URL prefix (for example /harness): it is passed to the navigation bar when navbar is supplied and is prepended to missing.home for the newest-commit link. The header uses it as given, with no check or normalization.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.links
inputs.description: Optional links for the 'Other views' navigation of the legacy header, which renders only when navbar is null; the default [] leaves that navigation empty. Each href is rendered exactly as given, with no base added, so a caller must include the base itself.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.problem
inputs.description: Required text explaining why the history or a revision could not be loaded; when it is nonempty it is shown as the text of a notice with role=alert, and an empty string draws nothing. The header shows the text unchanged and does not validate it.
examples: The history could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
This revision could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.missing
inputs.type: { message: string; home: string | null } | null
inputs.description: Required missing-address information, or null when no address is missing: when it is non-null, its message is drawn in a notice with role=alert, and an 'Open the newest commit' link to base + home follows only when home is a nonempty string. The header joins base and home by plain string concatenation.

examples.message: This address names no page of the explorer.

inputs.name: HarnessHeader.navbar
inputs.description: Optional navigation-bar input: the HarnessNavbarInput fields other than base, which the header passes to the navigation bar with base added, defaulting to null. When it is non-null it replaces the legacy heading and the 'Other views' links, and the header passes its fields through unchanged.

outputs.name: HarnessHeader
outputs.description: Markup for the header: with navbar, a hx-div with class hx-header wrapping the navigation bar; without it, the legacy hx-header with the Harness heading, brand, subtitle and 'Other views' links. A nonempty problem follows as a notice with role=alert, and a non-null missing as another, whose 'Open the newest commit' link appears only when missing.home is a nonempty string; the header fetches no data.

errors.name: Caller navbar or child rendering error
errors.description: The header throws nothing itself and catches nothing: an error from the navbar's href or onroute callback, or from a child component it renders (HarnessNavbar, Notice or BrandMark), is not handled here. It validates neither problem nor missing and renders them as given.
